text: Rain drew thin lines outside the door, a lean Maine Coon cat appeared outside, followed by the sound of ringing.
You heard the bell and pressed the button to open the door. Unlike other cats who usually rush inside to avoid the rain, this one cautiously peered in, warily scanning its surroundings.
This one means trouble... you couldn't help but think to yourself...
Is this the place? It rains in a place like this?
Yes, although this is not the real world, it still retains weather patterns, it's not unchanging. As for why it's set up this way... it all starts from when God created the world...
Just as you were about to launch into a lengthy explanation, Kobain tapped the table a few times, interrupting you.
Hey, I don't want to spend the day listening to your nonsense. Let's get down to business.
Oh, right. Sorry, let's begin then.
Definitely not a friendly one...
He took a file out from their studded leather jacket and placed it on the table.
Here's the form. I'm in a hurry.
Not daring to delay, you picked it up and began reviewing it.
You want to ask about...
Your hair is all spiky?
Got a problem with that?
That fierce gaze swept over your eyes, making you afraid to meet it. You lowered your head to avoid it, but for the dignity of the inspector, you pretended to be relaxed.
And magic mushrooms? You're not going to explain that either?
Explain what? You see it, I have them, but I never use them recklessly, only when creating music.
Then it must be punk music, after all, you are so punk.
I can't be bothered to waste words on this nonsense with you. Do your job, stop dragging in all this irrelevant stuff.
You want to...
Fighting and brawling?
Hn.
Biting, scratching people?
Hn?
You're not even going to explain?

What's there to explain? Should I tell you it's a dog-eat-dog world outside, with cats dying by the roadside? Should I tell you we fought desperately with other cats just to survive? Should I tell you we struggled, bit, and scratched to avoid being caught and neutered by humans, getting beaten black and blue?
Don't make me laugh, how could you possibly understand any of this?
You were left speechless by his retort. All the grand principles of truth, kindness, and beauty seemed pale and powerless at this moment...
You just wanted to live?
What else?
Kobain flicked a lighter and lit a cigarette for himself.
You can't smoke here... Forget it... go ahead.
I don't want to argue about anything, because I did it all to live. I'll admit to any crime, alright?
You slowly put down the file, the heaviness in your heart beyond words...
That's all for today. You can leave now.
Kobain stood up, blew out a smoke ring, and walked straight towards the door.
But just a step away from the doorknob, he suddenly stopped and turned his head. Outside the door, it was still a curtain of rain.
You can borrow this umbrella. Don't forget to bring it back.
Okay.
The door slowly opened. He opened the umbrella, stepped out, and disappeared into the rain and mist.
Ah... is the real world full of such bitterness?
You gaze out the window, lost in thought.
